plugins.name: seamark
plugins.description: End-to-end software delivery pipeline (refine → plan → implement → review → verify) with phase-marker enforcement, a configurable second engine for planning and review (Codex, Kimi, or none), parallel-lens fan-out review, Jira MCP integration, and per-stack expert modes.

plugins.name: seamark-status
plugins.description: Claude Code statusline with the Seamark mark, git and PR state, the live Seamark phase, and pace-aware usage bars. Single Python file, standard library only. Run /seamark-status:setup once to wire it into settings.json.
